learning_outcomes.text: Apply the principle of virtual work to bar structures.
Understand the most common structural typologies in industrial construction and the most appropriate modeling for their analysis.
Statically calculate or check bar structures and planar elements using matrix calculation and finite elements.

syllabus_topics: Planar bar structures with articulated nodes
Planar bar structures with rigid nodes
Introduction to FEM in structural calculation
assessment_rules: For ordinary and extraordinary evaluations, the final grade is calculated as (0.8 x T1) + (0.05 x TP) + (0.05 x P1) + (0.05 x P2) + (0.05 x P3). A minimum grade of 2 out of 10 is required for each exercise in the final exam (T1/T2), and a minimum of 4 out of 10 for the complete exam. For differentiated evaluation, the final grade is calculated as (0.9 x T1) + (0.1 x P1), with the same minimum grades for T1. In case of doubt regarding authorship or unauthorized means (e.g., AI tools), a face-to-face defense may be requested.
